title: Rewards are permanently locked when totalSupply = 0 in RecurPools
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the MasterBunni contract, when calculating rewards for RecurPools using the `_rewardPerToken` function, any rewards allocated during periods where `totalSupply = 0` become permanently locked in the contract. This occurs because:  1.
